scripts.build:core: npm run build --workspace @interceptor/core-protocol && npm run build --workspace @interceptor/proxy-core
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run start --workspace @interceptor/desktop
scripts.package: npm run build:core && npm run package --workspace @interceptor/desktop
scripts.make: npm run build:core && npm run make --workspace @interceptor/desktop
scripts.test:smoke: npm run package && npm run test:smoke --workspace @interceptor/desktop
